manifest_file_integrity.method: Before reviewing content, every declared path was read as bytes and its actual SHA-256 and byte length were compared with review_input_v4.json.

reviewer_independence.method: The final V4 candidate was reviewed anew from all five rendered_v4 full-resolution PNGs, rendered_v4 PDF, rendered_v4 contact sheet, markitdown_v4 frontstage text and notes, teaching master, 03A, 03B, complete rehearsal script and data snapshot. V2 failures, disposition and the V3 integrity-abort record were used only to establish traceability, never as substitute evidence.
reviewer_independence.write_scope: Only this JSON report was created. No manifest-listed candidate file was modified.

counting_rule: Counts are distinct issue classes. The single P1 is counted once although it affects the C103-to-C104 transition and C104's claimed generation state. Under the declared gate any P0, P1 or P2 causes FAIL.

C101.unique_visual_duty: Receive the complete first chapter before segmentation and identify which actions belong to the man and woman.
C101.first_glance: The complete five-line poem is the dominant object; actor-marking instructions remain secondary and no gloss, chapter answer, personality label or later fact is shown.
evidence: rendered_v4/slide-1.png shows all five lines at 31 pt in a large high-contrast central field.
03A contains only the complete poem, open actor marking, question marks and a correction line.
The rehearsal script limits peer checking to 'who did this' and postpones precise glosses to C102-C104.
C101.graphic_function: The unmarked poem preserves uncertainty; two color-coded prompt groups distinguish the two actor-marking operations without coloring the poem as an answer.
C101.deletion_and_merge_test: Credible. Removing or merging C101 into C102 would eliminate the whole-chapter unknown state and prematurely narrow attention to the first two lines.
C101.remaining_P3: Test last-row readability of the 19.5-23 pt instructions and whether unresolved vocabulary prevents some students from completing actor marking.

C102.unique_visual_duty: Make the shift from visible trade action to the woman's disclosed marriage purpose discoverable from the two lines while guarding against later-character backfill.
C102.first_glance: Both source lines dominate at 39 pt. Three question cards request observation, disclosure and the turning word without printing a translation or highlighting the answer.
evidence: rendered_v4/slide-2.png keeps both occurrences of '贸丝' and '匪/谋' in one visual field.
03B requires an individual natural paraphrase and turning word before teacher glosses.
markitdown_v4 notes delay all six glosses and the evidence-boundary synthesis until after student attempts.
C102.graphic_function: The central paired source lines support lexical comparison; the lower cards structure a return to textual evidence rather than illustrate a completed scene.
C102.deletion_and_merge_test: Credible. The old two-line fragment pages have already been merged; merging C102 into C103 would conflate a narrative reversal with a spatial-action task.
C102.picture_script_consistency: Consistent; no C102 or PDF line ends in an isolated character.
C102.remaining_P3: Verify that students discover '匪' from the source rather than merely infer it from the third question and that 20.5 pt question text remains readable from the last row.

C103.unique_visual_duty: Make '送-涉-至' operate as a continuous spatial response rather than a flat place-name paraphrase.
C103.first_glance: The original line and three widely separated verbs dominate; no completed route, direction, map or emotional label is displayed.
evidence: rendered_v4/slide-3.png displays the original at 44 pt and each target verb at 49 pt.
03B leaves the connection line to the student and forbids invented geographic detail.
The scripted activity uses finger movement, student pen trace, oral reconstruction and return to the original.
C103.graphic_function: The spacing between the three circles is the operative spatial object and remains incomplete until student action.
C103.deletion_and_merge_test: Credible. Its bodily/spatial channel is not replaceable by C102's lexical turn or C104's speech listening.
C103.picture_script_consistency: The C103 picture and main activity are consistent, but its final scripted transition corrupts the intended unknown state of the next page.

findings.issue: The natural transition spoken before C104 explicitly pre-names the exact interpretive categories C104 claims students will generate.
findings.direct_evidence: The complete V4 rehearsal script and markitdown_v4 notes end C103 with: '接下来，请听她怎样解释、安抚，又怎样约定。' C104 then asks students to fill four open slots and independently decide what the clauses are doing before teacher classification.
findings.release_impact: Although C104's slide and 03B no longer print '解释/安抚/约期', students have just heard those three labels from the teacher. They can map the four clauses onto supplied categories instead of naming the speech actions themselves. The package therefore cannot support its claim that classification is generated before calibration.
findings.required_disposition: Replace the C103-to-C104 transition with a neutral invitation that does not contain '解释', '安抚', '约期/约定' or equivalent categories; rebuild all dependent artifacts and issue a new immutable manifest for fresh review.

C104.unique_visual_duty: Let students construct the four clauses as one utterance, propose their own speech-action grouping, then receive a post-generation synthesis and retain the evidence boundary around '无怒'.
C104.first_glance: Considered in isolation, the slide is genuinely open: the two source lines dominate, the central prompt asks what the four clauses do, and four numbered slots contain no category names.
evidence: rendered_v4/slide-4.png and 03B show four blank positions, not '解释/安抚/约期'.
The slide contains no translation, later violence, completed grouping or model answer.
The C104 script asks for individual natural language and grouping, receives student versions, then supplies glosses and only afterward offers the three-layer synthesis.
However, the immediately preceding C103 transition orally supplies '解释、安抚、约定' before the 90-second C104 generation interval.
C104.answer_leak_channel: teacher transition immediately before page entry
C104.graphic_function: The four colored blanks are functionally aligned to student clause-by-clause language and allow later grouping; they are not decorative. The failure arises from the prior spoken state, not the shape design itself.
C104.deletion_and_merge_test: The two source lines appropriately remain together. A distinct dialogue page has credible deletion loss and should not merge with C105's support-removal assessment, but the current entry-state leak blocks release.
C104.picture_script_consistency: The picture is consistent with an open task; the full lesson script is not, because the preceding cut line supplies the categories the picture withholds.

findings.issue: C104 four slots are visually unlabelled but are not cognitively unlabelled on entry.
findings.release_impact: The visible repair alone does not restore student-first generation across the executable page sequence.
findings.required_disposition: Repair the preceding transition and re-review the complete sequence, not only C104's isolated image.

C104.remaining_P3: After transition repair, observe whether students can invent useful clause functions without excessive abstraction and whether peers can distinguish an unheard meaning from generic expressive-reading advice.

C105.unique_visual_duty: Reread the whole chapter, remove all local supports, retrieve a continuous account, repair one gap and create the first cell of the six-chapter story rail.
C105.first_glance: Before blackout, the complete source is readable at 29 pt; three oral retrieval prompts and the empty six-chapter rail make the assessment structure visible without showing a completed chapter meaning.
evidence: The C105 V4 note and full rehearsal script explicitly order: close textbook; turn both 03A and 03B face down; place them at the desk corner; peer-check that no poem remains visible; wait; press B to black out the projector.

After retrieval, the script restores only the textbook to locate one missing line, immediately closes it, keeps 03A and 03B face down, then turns back only 03B for writing the story rail while 03A remains face down.
03B itself prints the same material-control contract: textbook closed; 03A and 03B face down; narrate only after blackout.
The complete original is present in 03A, but V4 explicitly controls it rather than assuming that 'closed book' removes it.
No completed chapter answer or later marriage fact is projected. Teacher synthesis occurs after paired retrieval and personal story-rail writing.
ordered_support_state: Whole-chapter reread with screen and textbook
03A and 03B both face down at desk corner
Peer confirms no poem is visible
Thirty-second closed-support narration and peer gap check
Only textbook opens to locate one missing line, then closes before re-telling
Only 03B returns for first story-rail entry; 03A remains face down
C105.graphic_function: The two-column source-to-retrieval layout supports rereading followed by blackout; the bottom rail establishes chapter one as the first part of a growing six-chapter visual structure.
C105.deletion_and_merge_test: Credible. Without C105, local word, spatial and speech work would not be tested as a continuous story or transferred into the later rail. Merging it into C104 would erase the deliberate change from supported interpretation to unsupported retrieval.
C105.picture_script_consistency: Consistent and executable at desktop-script level.
C105.remaining_P3: Live-test whether the multi-object material-control routine fits the stated 30-second setup allowance, whether oral prompts survive projector blackout and whether the subdued 14-17.5 pt six-chapter rail remains legible from the back row.

global_findings.finding: The five-page architecture is coherent: whole-chapter actor tracking, purpose turn, spatial response, dialogue construction and unsupported story retrieval. Page formats vary by literary object and no fatal five-page template loop was found. The sole release blocker is the spoken category leak across the C103-to-C104 boundary.

Five full-resolution PNGs, contact and PDF show no overlap, clipping, overflow, missing glyph, placeholder, low-contrast core original or isolated broken character. C102 and C104 specifically contain no orphaned single-character wrap.
Original-text sizes are C101 31 pt, C102 39 pt, C103 44 pt, C104 38 pt and C105 29 pt, all above the stated 28 pt core-original threshold with strong contrast. Actual last-row projection remains P3.

No later marriage event or completed chapter answer is visible. Nevertheless, generation-before-calibration fails once because the executable C103 transition names '解释、安抚、约定' before C104's open classification.

C105 now explicitly controls textbook, 03A, 03B and projector, includes peer verification and restores supports in a bounded order. It constitutes a real scripted closed-support retrieval rather than a screen-only blackout claim.

release_gate.declared_rule: P0=0 and P1=0 and P2=0 in both independent reviews
minimum_reentry_conditions: Remove the C103-to-C104 spoken preclassification '解释、安抚、约定' and any equivalent category cue before C104 independent generation.
Regenerate all dependent source, teaching, PPTX, notes, PDF, PNG, contact, student-package and manifest artifacts so their hashes represent one immutable candidate.
Run fresh independent visual and student-reception reviews against the new immutable manifest.

claim_boundary.review_claim: This is a desktop, sequence-aware review of the exact immutable V4 package. It can verify visual artifacts, written support-control steps and contradictions between entry state and claimed student generation; it cannot establish observed learning or classroom timing.
not_claimed: No claim that real students have learned or retained the chapter.
No claim that projector blackout, peer material check or ordered restoration has been observed live.
No claim that 27-minute pacing or last-row readability has been empirically validated.
remaining_P3_observations_after_blocker_: Back-row readability of C101 lower instructions, C102 20.5 pt questions, C104 lower instructions and C105 subdued story rail.
Whether C102 prompts elicit discovery of '匪' rather than cue-driven guessing and whether C104 open clause naming is cognitively accessible without the leaked transition.
Whether C105 material withdrawal, peer verification, blackout, 30-second narration and ordered restoration run within the timebox without procedural attention overtaking the story.
